key.name: battery-details
key.description: The battery's menu in quick settings says when it will be empty or full, how many watts it takes, which apps used the most since it was last plugged in or out (an estimate from processor time), and the battery's health.

key.name: busy-app
key.summary: Say when an app is busy
key.description: When the processor has been at 70% or more for two minutes, a chip beside the meters names the app that used the most, once an hour at most, never for a fullscreen window in front. It needs the meters.

key.name: device-batteries
key.description: The battery's menu in quick settings lists the battery of every device that reports one (a mouse, a keyboard, headphones, a controller, the paired phone), and a notice says once when one is at 15% or less.

key.name: flat-battery
key.description: At 3% a card asks you to save and the computer closes cleanly 60 seconds later, unless you plug in or say Not yet. Where your apps were is kept, and they are offered back at the next start.

key.name: flat-hold
key.description: While the flat-battery card is on the screen, this key says Not yet. It is bound only then, so it takes nothing from your typing the rest of the time.
